lines.1: 「The bath is free. Why don't you use it?」
lines.4: Her pale skin was faintly flushed pink from the heat.
lines.6: So this was a third-year. An older woman!
lines.7: 「I usually just shower except in winter, though.」
lines.8: 「A bath relieves fatigue. You should soak.」
lines.10: Otome did not seem self-conscious in the least.
lines.11: She was the one who had moved in. It hardly seemed fair that I was the only one flustered...
lines.12: 「What is it? Is there something else?」
lines.13: 「Oh, no. Feel free to watch TV or whatever you want.」
lines.14: 「Thank you. Though I intend to study at this hour.」
lines.15: She really was serious about everything.
lines.16: 「I will be in my room if you need anything.」
lines.18: She had gone to the trouble of cleaning the bath and filling the tub for me.
lines.19: I supposed I might as well use it.
